name: model-salt
description: An MCP server with one tool: before a creative task the model calls it and gets back a few choices to settle this time, drawn from randomness outside the model (atmospheric and quantum noise), so one prompt gives different answers that still do what was asked.

tools.name: model_salt
tools.description: Call before a creative task. Returns a few choices to settle this time (a palette, a pose, a name, an opening line), drawn from random.org atmospheric noise, a quantum random number generator and the drand beacon. The model then does the request as asked; only the open choices move.

examples.title: Varied drawings from one prompt
examples.description: Run the same prompt several times and get different pictures that still match it.
examples.prompt: Make an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle.

examples.title: Varied names
examples.description: Get a different set of names each run instead of the usual favourites.
examples.prompt: Suggest five names for a small coffee shop by the sea.
